subject: The Dream of a Nation – a film on Lumumba & Andrée Blouin | Support and introductions
originalBody:
Dear Panzi Foundation team,

The work of Dr Mukwege and the Panzi teams in Bukavu is a source of pride for the Congo and for the world. Our film looks back at the night the Congo dreamt of its independence, and gives a Congolese story, and a woman's r
draftBody:
Dear Justin,

Thank you for reaching out to the Panzi Foundation and for sharing the story behind "The Dream of a Nation." We appreciate you taking the time to introduce your project, and we were moved by the care with which you are honoring Andrée Blouin's role alongside Patrice Lumumba — a chapter of Congo's history that deserves to be told with the depth and dignity you describe.

We have passed your message along to the appropriate members of our team, who will review your request and be in touch with you if there is a way for us to be of support.

Thank you again for thinking of us, and we wish you every success as you bring this project to completion.

With warm regards,
The Panzi Foundation Team
